description: This file defines the EmailQueueDao class, which extends BaseDao and manages database operations related to email queues, including retrieving, saving, deleting emails, and fetching pending email IDs in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmailQueueDao
classes.description: Data access object for email queue operations, provides methods to interact with email data in the database.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Retrieves a Mail entity by its ID.

methods.name: saveEmail
methods.description: Persists a Mail entity to the database.

methods.name: removeFromQueue
methods.description: Deletes multiple Mail entries from the database based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getAllPendingMailIds
methods.description: Fetches IDs of all mails with status 'pending'.
